hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.php$'; then if [ -x vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer ] && vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'formatted php'; elif [ ! -x vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer ]; then echo 'php-cs-fixer not found; skipping PHP formatting' >&2; else echo "php formatting failed: $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >&2; fi; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then FORMATTER=ruff; elif [ -x strands_agents/.venv/bin/ruff ]; then FORMATTER=strands_agents/.venv/bin/ruff; else FORMATTER=''; fi; if [ -n "$FORMATTER" ] && "$FORMATTER" format --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'formatted python'; elif [ -z "$FORMATTER" ]; then echo 'ruff not found; skipping Python formatting' >&2; else echo "python formatting failed: $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >&2; fi; fi
vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --error-format=raw 2>&1 | head -10; RUFF=$(command -v ruff || echo strands_agents/.venv/bin/ruff); $RUFF check strands_agents/ 2>&1 | head -10
